processId.description: Stable Qunux process identity for the current Codex session.

qunuxThreadId.description: Qunux logical thread that produced or owns the snapshot.

snapshot.description: Runtime snapshot payload. Currently mirrors the persisted Qunux closure state.

statePath.description: Optional persisted snapshot path for debug/offline fallback.

threadId.description: Codex thread that should receive and render this snapshot.
